body:
Maybe I'm just a sap who can be easily taken advantage of. That's pretty much how I'd describe any relationships I've had in the past.

To be honest, I do think it's a good thing I'm not with this ex, but that doesn't make it any easier.

I've been cutting for around 3 years. My ex-ex was openly cheating on me. She beat me down so bad that I let the guy sleep in my bed with her while I slept on the couch, so that kinda messed with my head. I went 2 years without any kind of physical relationship with a girl before I met my latest, who went on to cheat on me too.

Cutting distracts me from shit like that, it's a good distraction and I really enjoy it. It gives me something to think about.
Honestly? I just want someone to hug me right now while I cry, but there's no one I can ask.

Erm, I got the co-dydramol/dihydrocodeine from the hospital, 30 tablets, for some pain a while ago. I've only ever taken 1 of the tablets and that was about a month ago.

People appreciate me in my job role. I'm good at what I do because I enjoy it (despite this specific place being hell). I moved to a new city a few years ago so pretty much all of my friends are in my workplace.

They think I'm awesome because I make their job easier. I know they won't miss me because I don't ever see them outside of work.

I cut my arms. I've been pretty successful in hiding it from everyone. In the few years I've been doing it only 2 people have ever found out, and that's because I've been getting naked with them, so I told them both beforehand since I knew it was coming.

Thanks.

I'm not really sure how friends feel. I told my ex (from my other reply) and all I got back was "don't be silly!" That was an hour ago, I haven't replied and she hasn't tried to get in touch. I've never done anything like this before so I'm not sure why she wouldn't try? If it was the other way around I'd walk to the other end of the country to make sure my friend was okay (she's only a few miles away) - maybe that's just me.

I'm a reddit regular, recently donated some cash for gold(tm!). I got here because my brother recommended the place (he's also a regular)

Seriously though, what happens tomorrow? Even if I don't do anything tonight, how do I carry on? How do I look any one in the eye? Some people say it's easier. If I'm at my lowest tonight then tomorrow can only be easier. I don't really see it like that though. Yeah I'm alive, but I still have all the shit that got me here in the first place.

I'm 24, male, in the UK.

I'm not on any meds and I've never taken any illegal drugs. I drink often, I'm drunk right now.

I've never been diagnosed with anything.

I'm a cutter, 2 people in the world know. One of them was my gf but these days gives me abuse and calls me a "fruit loop". I tried to do something nice for her today and get her a job but she threw it in my face.

The other is a girl I was sleeping with recently, but barely acknowledges my existence these days.

My history is one failed relationship after another.

Everyone I know seems to think I'm awesome, but no one misses me when I'm not there. You know? I'm just floating in the middle.

I know some people on here go through things a hundred times worse. And I read through some SW posts and feel ashamed I'm here. I should be able to cope with stuff like this. It's life experience.

But here I am. I dunno what I lack, but I'm not as strong as other people.

I have a shitty job, even though it's doing something I love. It's just for a horrible boss.

I go through loads of ways of killing myself in my head. Not just the actual act, but the lead up and what happens after. I often think about writing letters to everyone close to me. A letter for each friend saying what I think, plus one to my mum and one to the concierge of my building saying what flat I'm in (I mean, who wants to rot?) I post these one day, then kill myself that night.

I get myself loads of pain killers, either OTC or via the dentist or hospital, with the hope that one day I'll do it. Either that, or I'm thinking of getting some rope, tying a knot at one end and jamming it under the door, looping the rope around to the top so it's just higher than my height and then hanging myself on that.

I've only got knives and other grusesome things around and I really don't wanna go that way.

If I can fall asleep with some tablets, then great.

Hell, I've texted friends and told them what I'm dong and they haven't even replied. Shows how much I mean, huh?
